title: ISS (Institute Sports Secretary)
summary: Sports Organising Committee, representatives, varsity teams and sporting clubs.

posts.md:
The **Institute Sports Secretary (ISS)** is responsible for promoting and managing sports activities at IIT Madras.

Working alongside the Physical Training Instructors (PTIs), the ISS oversees institute sports facilities, inter-hostel competitions, varsity teams, sporting clubs, and student-led sports initiatives.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the Institute Sports Secretary.

## Contents

Sports Organizing Committee (SOC)

Student Representatives

Varsity Teams & Sporting Clubs

## Sports Organizing Committee (SOC)

The **Sports Organizing Committee (SOC)** is the primary student body responsible for planning and executing sports events at IIT Madras.

SOC organizes major tournaments such as:

Jimmy George

Sports Fest

GF&KR

Agrata

## Student Representatives

## Women's Representative

Represents women athletes and promotes participation in sports through dedicated tournaments and initiatives.

### Responsibilities

- Women's Schroeter

- Women's sports development

- Inter-IIT support

## PG Representative

Represents postgraduate students and promotes sports participation among research scholars.

### Activities

- PG leagues

- Beginner sports camps

## Varsity Teams & Sporting Clubs

## Institute Varsity Teams

Institute teams represent IIT Madras in prestigious tournaments, including the **Inter-IIT Sports Meet**.

Major sports include:

- Athletics

- Badminton

- Basketball

- Chess

- Cricket

- Football

- Hockey

- Squash

- Swimming

- Table Tennis

- Tennis

- Volleyball

- Water Polo

- Weightlifting

Regular selections and practice sessions are conducted to prepare these teams for competition.

## Sporting Clubs

Sporting Clubs encourage recreational sports and allow students of all skill levels to participate.

Activities include:

- Beginner sessions

- Weekend games

- Recreational leagues

- Skill development

## Independent Sports Clubs

Apart from varsity teams, IIT Madras also has several independent sports clubs that promote recreational and adventure sports.

### Clubs

Cycling Club

Frisbee Club

Adventure Club

Bridge Club

Gymnesia Club

These clubs organize workshops, beginner sessions, weekend activities, and community events throughout the year.

**Did you know?**

From **Inter-IIT Sports** and flagship tournaments like **Jimmy George** and **Agrata** to recreational sporting clubs and beginner camps, the Institute Sports teams provide opportunities for every student—whether you're a competitive athlete or simply looking to stay active and have fun on campus.
